title: 105′ Italian Motor Yacht: Distinctive Luxury Overview
description: 2012 105-foot Italian motor yacht, refit 2023: 24-ft beam, full-beam master, flybridge with bar, MTU power.
html:
This 105-foot (32 m) Italian motor yacht combines a broad 24-foot beam and sleek, contemporary exterior lines to deliver generous interior volume and striking presence at anchor. Built in 2012 and moored in Miami, she comfortably accommodates up to ten guests across five guest staterooms plus additional crew accommodation (seven cabins total), with a full-beam master suite that maximizes privacy and natural light. The interior flows from an expansive salon and formal dining area into a fully equipped galley, while exterior teak decks and a substantial flybridge expand the options for relaxed days and evenings afloat.

Performance and Technology Highlights with 2023 Refit

Underway performance is driven by twin high-output MTU diesels rated at 2,400 HP each, delivering a top speed around 26 knots and a cruise envelope that balances speed with efficiency; a 6.25 ft draft and wide beam contribute to a stable, confident ride. A comprehensive refit in 2023 focused on systems and cosmetics, bringing navigation electronics, communications, and interior finishes up to date and ensuring engines, generators and auxiliary systems were serviced to contemporary standards. Modern helm displays and updated safety systems make passage planning and handling both safer and more intuitive.

Guest Accommodations and Layout: Five Staterooms

Guest arrangements center on five well-appointed staterooms configured for ten guests, anchored by a lavish full-beam master suite with generous storage and en suite amenities; additional accommodations typically include a forward VIP and two guest cabins that can be arranged as doubles or twins, each with private facilities. The main salon opens to the dining area and galley, creating an easy flow for entertaining and casual living. Separate crew quarters and access routes maintain service discreetness and ensure guest privacy during charters or private use.

Exterior Entertaining Areas: Flybridge, Decks, Sunroof

Outdoor living is a major asset: the teak-decked flybridge offers an integrated bar, lounge seating and a retractable sunroof for flexible shade or sun exposure, while aft deck dining and foredeck sunpads provide multiple zones for meals, sunbathing and socializing. Wide side decks and an aft swim platform simplify water access and tender operations, and the layout accommodates convivial evenings under the stars as comfortably as daytime cruising in the islands.

Engineering, Propulsion and Stabilization Systems Overview

The propulsion train centers on twin MTU 2400 HP engines paired with robust gearboxes and control systems, backed by ABT-TRAC active fin stabilizers to reduce roll at anchor and when underway. Redundant electrical generation and modern HVAC systems were addressed during the 2023 refit, and the updated electronics suite supports contemporary navigation, radar and autopilot features. The combination of powerful propulsion, stabilization and shallow 6.25 ft draft makes her well suited to coastal cruising around Florida and the Bahamas while maintaining comfortable sea-keeping offshore.

Key Features Recap and Next Steps to Discover More

Notable attributes include the 105-foot overall length with a 24-foot beam for voluminous living spaces, five guest staterooms for ten guests plus crew cabins, twin MTU 2400 HP engines with a 26-knot top speed, ABT-TRAC stabilization and a 2023 refit that modernized systems and finishes; expansive exterior areas such as a teak flybridge with bar and sunroof complete the package. For experienced owners or charter operators seeking a refined, high-performance platform based in Miami, this yacht offers an attractive balance of comfort, speed and onboard amenities.
